rs.trigger_condition: When global embeddings dilute irregular regions, align mask-conditioned and cropped features with long region descriptions.
rs.abstract_strategy: 用局部和全局双视图约束表征。
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When finer localization loses context, preserve both granularities during training.
